applied_findings.title: Redirect test relies on task scheduling delay
applied_findings.resolution: Directly await opening on the MainActor; schedule only its finish callback, removing the unstructured opening task and fixed delay.
applied_findings.verification: Focused redirect regression passed after the fix.

testing_limits: Live Dots editor/send/receipt compatibility remains unverified. Read-only live DOM observations establish selectors, while local fixtures append synthetic outgoing message rows and replies. No live Send exercised the service's editing events, message-ID lifecycle, or history transitions during receipt polling.

Live authenticated Dots avatar snapshots and logout remain unverified. The supplied real login destination /auth/login?next=%2Fdots matches the path-clearing guard, and the populated-avatar fixture covers same-URL sign-out and persisted cache removal; live custom CSS pet capture and an actual logout DOM/routing transition were not exercised.

Add a negative signedOut fixture case where a responsive sidebar hides Your dot actions while the conversation contains a visible Sign in link. WebPageScript.swift:78 searches all visible buttons/links and :89 checks only visible account controls; WebAgentSession.swift:270-275 clears savedAvatar and dotsURL on that combination. The populated-avatar fixture presently covers the positive hidden-chat/login case.
